reading: People can now buy and sell shares in Anthropic on the stock market.
Shares are small parts of a company.
Anthropic makes Claude, a popular artificial intelligence (AI) tool that can talk with people.
The company started just five years ago.
Its share price was set at $83 before trading began.
The price rose to $111.53, but it fell later that day.
Each share cost $97.17 at the end of the day.
Some investors, people who put money into companies, said the first day seemed to be a success.
The price changes seemed to show that investors were still unsure about the future of AI.

vocabulary.definition: Small parts of a company that people can buy and sell.
Liked or used by many people.
